description: Deterministic native Page Builder content composer (G3, issue #23): composes persisted master-format HTML from a pinned NodeIR/PageStructure/registry/manifest — pure computation, no filesystem, no network, no write operations. This slice composes exactly the hero shape (full-width background media + overlaid text + CTA) as native row(contained) > banner(poster), per the platform's own content-type declarations and its own master-format markup. Native targets are verified against the pinned registry first; every planned source node is accounted for in the mapping (mapped / gap / decoration-merged / excluded / skipped); missing content inputs and non-representable decorations come back as NOT_VERIFIED gap warnings — never invented around, never embedded as arbitrary HTML. Structural composition evidence only: no Admin round-trip or visual claim.
